subject: Request: above-band merit + one-time equity refresh for Rae Thompson
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: above-band merit + one-time equity refresh for Rae Thompson

Team —

Quick ask: I’d like to request approval for an above-band merit increase and a one-time equity refresh for Rae Thompson (Sr. Engineer, Eng Infra). Context: Rae is a top performer, just declined an external counteroffer last week and has indicated they’re evaluating long-term options. We’ve maxed headroom for base given band constraints; this request combines a 7% above-band merit (one-time pro-rated payout style) plus a 0.25% one-time RSU refresh to retain them through H2.

Why this matters:
- Direct impact: Rae is the lead on the new KV cache optimization; rev timeline depends on them staying through Q4.
- Replacement risk is high and market comps indicate we’re ~15% below offers in this role.

Request (proposed):
- Base salary: no change (band cap reached)
- Merit: 7% one-time cash payout (effective next payroll)
- Equity: 0.25% one-time RSU grant, 3-year vesting, cliff at 6 months
- Effective date: 2026-08-01

Attached: performance summary and comp impact model. Budget impact is shown in comp_impact_model_Q3.xlsx; rough estimate is $48k FY run-rate (equity modeled). I’m asking for sign-off from People Ops (Neha), Finance (Monica), and any legal or leadership concerns from Laura/Vivek.

Please reply with: APPROVE / REQUEST CHANGE / DECLINE and any suggested delta. I’d like to finalize by EOD Friday so we can get the DocuSign template queued.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: above-band merit + one-time equity refresh for Rae Thompson

Jonas — thanks for the note and the packet. Quick thoughts:

- I support retention steps for high-impact ICs where banding prevents market-competitive base adjustments.
- Two asks before final sign-off: (1) Neha, confirm precedent for a 6-month cliff on a one-time refresh (we usually do 1y vest on top-ups, want to ensure we’re not creating inconsistency); (2) Monica, confirm budget alignment with our Q3 hiring/comp bucket.

If both checks are green, I’m inclined to APPROVE the 7% cash + 0.25% RSU. If Finance flags runway, consider a staged payout for the cash portion to spread FY impact.

Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent | Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick operational answers and next steps:

1) Vesting/precedent: People Ops confirms we can do a 6-month cliff on a time-limited retention grant for critical hires as an exception; we will document the rationale in the file.

2) Finance: Monica confirmed the Q3 comp pool can absorb the one-time cash payout as requested if we treat it as a one-off (category: retention incentives). Monica — please confirm if you want staged payout language and I’ll update the offer.

3) Mercer (cc’d) provided a quick market note; mjones reports the proposed combined package lands within 75th percentile for market comps in the Northern CA cohort.

Decision summary:
- APPROVE: 7% one-time cash payout
- APPROVE: 0.15% RSU one-time refresh (compromise per Vivek)
- Vesting: 6-month cliff, 3-year schedule

Operational next steps:
- Jonas: confirm final numbers you want in the DocuSign offer (I’ll prepare the template).
- Monica: once you confirm staging (if desired), I’ll file the transaction and route to payroll.
- Legal: if anyone needs to review language, flag now — otherwise I’ll proceed.

I’ll queue the DocuSign link and share a draft before sending to Rae.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference
